parts.title: Part 1 · Introduction and Interview
prompts: How long have you lived there?
Do you plan to live there for a long time?
What kinds of films do you like best?
How often do you watch films?

parts.title: Part 2 · Cue Card
parts.cueCardTitle: Describe a leisure activity you enjoy.
cueCardBullets: When and where you do it

parts.title: Part 3 · Discussion
prompts: Do you think people should only focus on work?
How much leisure time should adults have each week?
Should parents plan their children's leisure activities?
How are young people's activities different from those of older generations?
